skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the strategic importance of managing information resources.
Develop strategic plans for managing information resources.
Integrate information systems into organizational processes to enhance efficiency and competitiveness.
Manage projects related to information resource management.
Analyze existing systems and propose improvements for information resource management.
